nl.title: Uitleg over DirectAdmin controlpanel
nl.excerpt: Wat DirectAdmin is en waar je domeinen, mail, bestanden en accountinstellingen vindt.
nl.bodyHtml:
DirectAdmin is het controlpanel voor websites, e-mail, DNS, databases, FTP en backups bij TripleZero iT.

Voorbereiding

  • DirectAdmin-login
  • Minstens één domein op het account

Stappen

  1. Log in
  2. Bekijk Account Manager (usage, password, 2FA)
  3. Open Domain Setup voor domeinen
  4. Open E-mail Accounts voor mailboxen
  5. Open File Manager onder System Info & Files

Controleren

  • Domeinen en usage zichtbaar
  • File Manager opent zonder fout

Tip: Gebruik de zoekbalk in Evolution-skin als labels anders heten.

Let op: Users wijzigen geen serverbrede CustomBuild-opties.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: da-login; filemanager.

en.title: Guide about DirectAdmin controlpanel
en.excerpt: Guide about DirectAdmin controlpanel: what it is, where to manage it at TripleZero iT (DirectAdmin), and what to watch for.
en.bodyHtml:
Guide about DirectAdmin controlpanel comes up often with hosting, DNS, email or your control panel. Below is what it means and how you use it in practice at TripleZero iT.

You usually manage this via DirectAdmin. Always select the correct domain or account before changing anything.

In short

  • Guide about DirectAdmin controlpanel matters when you change configuration, availability or security of your services.
  • Wrong assumptions lead to wrong fixes: first confirm DNS, panel and application belong to the same domain.
  • Note your current setup (product, domain, panel) so the guidance matches your situation.

Where to manage it

  1. Sign in to DirectAdmin.
  2. Select the domain or subscription that “Guide about DirectAdmin controlpanel” applies to.
  3. Open the matching section (DNS, email, files, SSL, applications or account).
  4. Only change what you understand; take a backup before risky steps.

Practical points

  • Change one critical setting at a time so you can see cause and effect.
  • Always test outside the panel (browser, mail client or DNS lookup).
  • If you are unsure about impact on mail, SEO or checkout: read related articles or open a ticket.

Tip: Summarise in one sentence what “Guide about DirectAdmin controlpanel” means for your project before you change anything.

Note: Do not reuse passwords across services. Enable 2FA wherever available.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Also browse other knowledge-base articles on hosting, email and security.
